$comment: Reference-only fragment, not an active values.schema.json. Helm auto-validates only a values.schema.json file at a chart's own root, and only for the values that chart itself declares — this library chart's values are supplied by the consuming umbrella chart, not by installing platform-tracing directly, so a root-level values.schema.json here would never run against the values that matter. This file documents the shape the umbrella chart should merge under its own platformTracing key; no automated process reads or applies it. Copying it into the umbrella schema and keeping both in sync is the umbrella owner's responsibility.

endpoint.description: Value of OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT. Defaults to the shared Infra Collector (grpc, port 4317).
